evals.prompt: I just cloned this repo on my Windows laptop and want BQ/OpenBB Workspace running locally for the first time. Please set it up, start it, and tell me when it is actually ready.
evals.expected_output: Uses setup, run, then test scripts; reports HEALTHY only if verification passes; does not reconstruct Docker, Bun, env, credential, or process commands.

evals.prompt: Is my local OpenBB Workspace stack healthy right now? Do a status check only; do not restart or modify anything.
evals.expected_output: Runs only the read-only test script, gives a sanitized verified status, and does not invoke setup, run, stop, raw Compose, or Bun.

evals.prompt: Safely stop my local Workspace. The last start complained that a frontend PID file already existed, and Docker Desktop may currently be stopped. Recover only what is necessary and don't kill unrelated Bun or Docker processes.
evals.expected_output: Uses the stop script for owned cleanup, handles Docker-stopped or stale-PID failure without broad process kills, and provides one focused recovery action without printing secrets.
